description:
French Language pack
Features:
French dictionary based on AOSP - https://android.googlesource.com/platform/packages/inputmethods/LatinIME/+/master/dictionaries/
Include four keyboard layouts, AZERTY, QWERTY, BÉPO and Ergo-L, with many symbols and rapid acces to apostrophe and hyphen.
This is an expansion language pack for AnySoftKeyboard.
Install AnySoftKeyboard first, and then select the French keyboard from AnySoftKeyboard Settings -> Languages -> Keyboards menu.
